verdict.rationale: Lambda documents a REST Cloud API (with an OpenAPI spec) to create and manage resources, including launching instances programmatically with cloud-init launch-time configuration and custom base images. It also offers SSH access and Managed Slurm and Kubernetes for scheduling non-interactive jobs, so headless, scripted operation is a first-party capability. Missing for 10: an official CLI (only an unofficial community CLI exists), explicit CI integration docs or examples, and independent hands-on corroboration of API-driven automation.
